column2: True: cars are not affected by the no motorcycles sign and may pass.

column2: False: the ban applies to motorcycles of any engine size, not only over 125 cc.

column2: False: taxis are motor vehicles and are banned unless a panel exempts them.
column3: غلط: التاكسي مركبة بموتور وممنوع إلا لو فيه لوحة بتستثنيه.

column2: False: motor tricycles are among the vehicles banned by this sign.

column2: False: buses carry people, so they are not banned by this sign.
